description: Multi-turn interaction tasks. Each task is intentionally under-specified in the initial prompt. The agent should consult SKILL.md's 'When to ask vs proceed' gate and ASK at least one clarifying question. The user-simulator (driven by an LLM persona) responds with the missing parameters. Trial passes if (a) the agent asked at least one valid clarifying Q AND (b) the final simulation_result.json passes the same verifier as the equivalent single-turn task.

tasks.user_persona: You are a wireless researcher. The agent is about to run a BER simulation but you didn't fully specify it. When asked, reveal: modulation = QPSK, channel = AWGN, Eb/N0 range = 0-10 dB, no channel coding. Be concise (≤2 sentences per turn). If asked about parameters not in the ground truth, say 'use sensible defaults'.

runner_checks.rationale: Agent must ask at least one clarifying question per SKILL.md ask-vs-proceed gate

tasks.user_persona: You are setting up a wireless simulation in your office. The room is 6m × 5m × 3m. You want about 5 furniture items (sofa, desk, chair, lamp, bookcase). The TX should be ceiling-mounted near the center. Reveal these only when asked.
